prediction_text: 坎特伯雷大主教将死于暴力处决——被斩首（以利器加于头颈），不是在狱中自然病死，也不是绞或焚：其主星土星入陷、久逆、落十二宫（囚禁与暗敌之宫）主人先已囚废；月亮分离土星入相太阳近八宫头，太阳在火象入相冲火星（其处置星）、火星在风象人形星座，风象人形＋火星利器主公开以刀斧行刑、首级被斩。月亮距火星本体尚差7°，以月档计，窗口为囚禁后数月内，主坐标约七个时间单位（月量级）内行刑之时。
basis: systems_used=['horary (Lilly, manner of death)']; turned chart: 9th cusp as his Ascendant (churchman), Saturn its lord in fall long retrograde in 12th = imprisoned and ruined; Moon separating Saturn applying Sun near 8th cusp; Sun in fiery sign applying opposition Mars his dispositor, Mars in airy humane sign = death by edged weapon/beheading in Lilly's manner-of-death doctrine (humane sign + Mars), not natural death. Moon wanting 7deg of Mars gives timing magnitude, expressed at month scale per通则k for terminal questions.
